text: Maine yeh mixer grinder pichhle mahine liya tha, bahut badhiya chalta hai. Dobara yahi company ka product kharidunga.
why_unambiguous: Latin-script Hindi/English code-mix (maine/pichhle mahine/badhiya mixed with mixer grinder/product/company); pure praise; explicit repurchase intent (dobara ... kharidunga = will buy again); no defect.

text: Bilkul bekaar phone hai, teen din mein hi screen kharab ho gayi. Mujhe mera paisa wapas chahiye, refund do abhi.
why_unambiguous: Entirely negative; explicit refund demand (paisa wapas chahiye, refund do abhi) which is urgency=high by definition; Latin-script Hindi/English mix.

text: Geyser on karte hi current laga aur bijli ka jhatka mila, haath mein dard ho gaya. Bahut khatarnak hai, please isse mat kharido.
why_unambiguous: Electric shock with physical pain (bijli ka jhatka, haath mein dard) is a physical-harm/safety hazard, urgency=high by definition; the reviewer warns others off; Latin-script Hindi/English mix.

text: यह मिक्सर बहुत खराब है, दो दिन में ही खराब हो गया। मैं इसे दोबारा कभी नहीं खरीदूंगा।
why_unambiguous: Entirely Devanagari script (language=hi); entirely negative (बहुत खराब, दो दिन में ही खराब हो गया); explicit statement that they will never buy it again (दोबारा कभी नहीं खरीदूंगा).

text: Delivery time par aa gayi aur packing bhi achhi thi. Product theek-thaak hai, na zyada achha na bura.
why_unambiguous: The reviewer states outright that the product is neither good nor bad (na zyada achha na bura) with no complaint and no strong praise: neutral, no defect so urgency=low; Latin-script Hindi/English mix.

text: Sound quality ekdum mast hai lekin battery sirf do ghante chalti hai, yeh bahut badi problem hai.
why_unambiguous: One clearly positive element (sound quality ekdum mast) and one clearly negative element (battery sirf do ghante, bahut badi problem), which is the definition of mixed; Latin-script Hindi/English mix.

text: Is kurte ka kapda bahut soft hai aur fitting perfect hai. Maine do aur order kar diye hain.
why_unambiguous: Pure praise (kapda bahut soft, fitting perfect); having ordered two more (do aur order kar diye) is explicit repurchase behaviour; Latin-script Hindi/English mix.

text: Charger ka wire garam hokar jal gaya aur chingari nikli, ghar mein aag lag sakti thi. Company ko turant action lena chahiye.
why_unambiguous: Burning wire with sparks and an explicit fire risk (jal gaya, chingari, aag lag sakti thi) is a safety hazard, urgency=high by definition; demand for action; Latin-script Hindi/English mix.

text: Yeh kitaab bahut acchi hai, bachchon ko pasand aayi. Paisa vasool!
why_unambiguous: Pure praise (bahut acchi, pasand aayi, paisa vasool), no defect so urgency=low; Latin-script Hindi/English mix.

text: बैटरी बहुत जल्दी खत्म हो जाती है लेकिन कैमरा शानदार है।
why_unambiguous: Entirely Devanagari script (language=hi); one clear negative (बैटरी बहुत जल्दी खत्म) and one clear positive (कैमरा शानदार), which is the definition of mixed.

text: Bluetooth baar baar disconnect ho jata hai, bahut irritating hai.
why_unambiguous: A concrete fixable defect (bluetooth repeatedly disconnecting) with no harm and no refund/return demand is urgency=medium by the rubric; negative tone (bahut irritating); Latin-script Hindi/English mix.

text: Main isse dobara nahi lunga, bilkul paise barbaad. Packaging bhi tooti hui thi.
why_unambiguous: Explicit statement that they will not buy it again (dobara nahi lunga), entirely negative (paise barbaad, tooti hui packaging); Latin-script Hindi/English mix.
